capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.description: Employee allocation across teams and projects. Allocations come from Teams Management and from the proposed members of projects that have no formed team yet.
capacity.emptyOver: No over-allocated employees in this unit.

reviews.title: Portfolio reviews
reviews.description: Quarterly portfolio reviews: a decision per project. Hold and cancel decisions start a change request — they never change a project directly.

review.commentRequired: A comment is required for this decision.
review.completeDescription: Completing the review never changes a project directly. Hold and cancel decisions start change requests that go through the normal approval chain; re-scope opens a draft change request for the project manager.
review.readOnly: This review is completed and read-only.
review.empty: No active projects in your scope.
